claims.action: rushed to capital after Lin Qing uprising
warned about Henan corruption before Huaxian rebellion
rebelled in Western Regions then captured
audited silver vault and refused bribes
whipped eunuch outriders on eastern tour
donated salary and retained Zhao Ruhe for flood relief

selected Zuo Zongtang from leftover papers

claims.assessment: blunt and upright, bold in responsibility
stern and upright; devoted to moral principle
mastered government; proposals matched the moment
foremost among Manchu capital officials in integrity

claims.statement: fell ill from grief while mourning his mother

claims.action: declined Hunan educational commissioner while in mourning for mother

translationRepairs: The Ministry of Revenue drafted a plan noting that the imperial clan was expanding daily while its members depended entirely on state stipends—a major fiscal drain. It proposed reclassifying all descendants of the dynastic founder and earlier as jueluo, with each new jueluo generation subject to successive reductions in rank and allowance.

The Ministry of Revenue drafted a plan noting that the imperial clan was expanding daily while its members depended entirely on state stipends—a major fiscal drain. It proposed reclassifying all descendants of the Shizu Emperor and earlier as jueluo, with each new jueluo generation subject to successive reductions in rank and allowance.
s0069 has 世祖以上子孫; 世祖 is the temple name Shizu (Shunzhi), not the dynastic founder (太祖). Replacing 'dynastic founder' with 'the Shizu Emperor' corrects a real naming error.

The Ministry of Revenue drafted a proposal: imperial clansmen daily multiplied, and food and clothing all depended on official provision—a great drain on finances. It requested that from descendants of the Taizu on upward all be changed to jueluo status, and that those made jueluo be reduced in rank in succession.

The Ministry of Revenue drafted a proposal: imperial clansmen daily multiplied, and food and clothing all depended on official provision—a great drain on finances. It requested that from descendants of the Shizu on upward all be changed to jueluo status, and that those made jueluo be reduced in rank in succession.
The same unit writes 世祖, not 太祖. Rendering it as Taizu invents the wrong temple name; Shizu matches the Chinese.

Early in Daoguang he memorialized that Zhejiang's salt monopoly was poorly coordinated, proposing abolition of the salt commissioner's office, placing oversight under the governor-general, and a crackdown on smuggling together with abuses such as rule-bending, overweight charges, and illicit levies for supplies. The reforms were enacted as he proposed.

Early in Daoguang he memorialized that Zhejiang's salt monopoly was poorly coordinated, proposing abolition of the salt commissioner's office, placing oversight under the governor, and a crackdown on smuggling together with abuses such as rule-bending, overweight charges, and illicit levies for supplies. The reforms were enacted as he proposed.
s0091 says 歸巡撫兼理; 巡撫 is the provincial governor. Governor-general would be 總督, which is absent here.

In the early Daoguang period he memorialized that Zhejiang salt administration lacked unified control, requesting abolition of the salt commissioner, return of management to the governor-general's concurrent charge, and orders to rectify suppression of smuggling and strictly forbid such abuses as skimming rules, overweight levies, and supply exactions; it was carried out as proposed.

In the early Daoguang period he memorialized that Zhejiang salt administration lacked unified control, requesting abolition of the salt commissioner, return of management to the governor's concurrent charge, and orders to rectify suppression of smuggling and strictly forbid such abuses as skimming rules, overweight levies, and supply exactions; it was carried out as proposed.
Literal likewise mistranslates 巡撫 as governor-general; 'governor's concurrent charge' restores the office named in 歸巡撫兼理.

In his later years catastrophic floods struck repeatedly, above all in Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and the lake provinces. Coming on the heels of the Western Region campaigns, the treasury was severely depleted.
Year after year there were great floods; Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and the lake provinces suffered especially often. Coming on the heels of the Western Region campaigns, the treasury was severely depleted.
s0068 opens 瀕年大水: successive/recent years of flooding, not Wu Xiaoming's later life (晚年). The proposed 'Year after year there were great floods' matches 瀕年 and keeps 被災尤數.
In the fourth year of Daoguang he was promoted to grand preceptor of the Heir Apparent.
In the fourth year of Daoguang he was promoted to Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
s0025 has only 擢詹事. 詹事 is Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent; grand preceptor would be 太傅/太子太師, which the Chinese does not say.
In the fourth year of Daoguang he was promoted to grand preceptor.
In the fourth year of Daoguang he was promoted to Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent.
The literal also renders 詹事 as grand preceptor. Supervisor of the Household of the Heir Apparent is the correct office title for 詹事.
